assets.title: Old-eigenbasis Weil square-shell repair crossover has Landau-Widom order

statement_or_tool_contract.statement: For the canonical Weil square-shell chain L_n=log n, if repair is constrained to the first r eigenmodes of the old-window block, the Feshbach crossover rank r_old(n) required to recover the raw shell coercive scale grows on the Landau-Widom/Shannon order Theta(n^2 log n), with 4 n^2 log n as the current model scale.

assets.claim_scope: Asymptotic n -> infinity for the canonical square-shell model and the old-eigenbasis repair rule defined in the source finding; not a statement about response-optimal repair rank.

validation.validated_envelope: Floating canonical square-shell finite sections n in {2,3,4}; old-eigenmode repair only.
validation.summary: Observed crossovers roughly 10-16, 32-40, 72-88 against model scales 11.09, 39.55, 88.72 for n=2,3,4. Later SVD/inertia work restricted the claim to the non-optimal old-eigenbasis carrier.

known_failures: The stronger claim OPTIMAL_RESPONSE_RANK = 4 n^2 log n is inconsistent with the tested finite response-SVD/inertia model and is excluded from this asset.
assets.falsifier_or_kill_condition: Certified larger-n old-eigenbasis crossover data or a theorem showing growth not Theta(n^2 log n), under the same operator/repair definition.
assets.promotion_target: Derive a rigorous operator model and two-sided asymptotic bounds for r_old(n), or replace the asymptotic claim by a rigorously supported narrower law.
assets.notes: Historical backfill. RESTRICTED records the already-known weakening from an optimal-rank interpretation to the old-eigenbasis carrier only.

assets.title: Prime-dominated Weil response rank obeys a phase-space dangerous-region law

statement_or_tool_contract.statement: For fixed interior singular threshold eta in (0,1), the effective rank of the normalized prime-dominated Weil square-shell response is asymptotically governed by the phase-space volume of the dangerous region of an appropriate normalized Wiener-Hopf/pseudodifferential symbol, with a lower-order boundary/plunge correction.

assets.claim_scope: Canonical Weil square-shell response; fixed interior thresholds eta away from the extreme threshold 1; requires an actual symbol/model derived from the normalized response rather than a heuristic absolute-value surrogate.

validation.validated_envelope: Structural/floating probes for n in {2,3,4}; prime-cross ablation and finite threshold-inertia counts. No certified asymptotic envelope.
validation.sample_size_or_exhaustive_count: 3 finite n values plus exact partial-reflection/pair-kernel reductions
validation.summary: Exact reductions identify a prime partial-reflection frame and the classical phase-space spectral-count adapter; finite ablation indicates prime cross-coupling dominates near-critical response directions for n=2,3,4. The normalized response symbol and transfer bounds remain unproved.

known_failures: The earlier pure shell-Shannon ~4n mechanism is not retained as the primary asymptotic law.
Prime dominance does not imply rank equals the number of prime-power shifts.
Fixed-threshold spectral counts do not by themselves control the top singular value at 1 or prove RH.
assets.falsifier_or_kill_condition: A rigorous normalized-response analysis showing no applicable symbol/phase-space asymptotic, or certified large-scale threshold counts incompatible with every admissible derived symbol model under controlled remainder bounds.
assets.promotion_target: Derive the normalized response symbol/model, verify the required Szego/Widom hypotheses or an adapted arithmetic variant, control operator/HS/truncation errors, and compare against certified block-inertia counts.
assets.notes: Historical backfill of the replacement hypothesis that superseded the strongest shell-Shannon interpretation.

assets.title: Navier-Stokes phase-aware effective modulation dimension is at most one on the Enterprise closure route

statement_or_tool_contract.statement: In a suitable phase-aware dyadic norm that preserves modulation j, helicity and four-STAR/Walsh path information, the coherent effective modulation population of the full heterochiral unequal-shell Navier-Stokes interaction network obeys M_N <= C_epsilon N^(1+epsilon) for every epsilon>0, once the six-axis / four-STAR / 120-degree closure structure is fully accounted for.

assets.claim_scope: Enterprise six-axis/four-STAR/120-degree Navier-Stokes route; dyadic frequency N; phase-aware effective modulation population. This is not yet asserted as a theorem about arbitrary collapsed branch counts.

proved: Exact four-STAR Walsh decomposition and recorded branch cancellations from parent research notes

validation.validated_envelope: No uniform infinite-scale validation envelope. Supporting ingredients are exact finite/lattice reductions and exact branch-cancellation identities; the N^(1+epsilon) aggregation law itself remains unverified.
validation.summary: Each fixed modulation layer has an almost one-derivative sparse gain, while unrestricted aggregation loses exactly the square-root cost of O(N^2) branches. The conjecture asserts that Enterprise phase/helicity/path structure reduces coherent effective dimension from 2 to at most 1.

known_failures: No automatic N^(1+epsilon) bound is presently proved for the full classical Navier-Stokes modulation coherence.
A half-derivative counting gain, even if proved, is not automatically a complete global-regularity proof.
assets.falsifier_or_kill_condition: Construct a family of admissible interactions within the same typed carrier whose phase-aware coherent modulation population has lower growth exponent strictly greater than 1, or prove an unavoidable N^(2-o(1)) coherence mechanism.
assets.promotion_target: Define the phase-aware norm canonically and prove the N^(1+epsilon) effective-modulation bound, then separately quantify its PDE regularity consequence.
assets.notes: Historical backfill from a precise directional research target; not promoted from the exact fixed-j estimates.

assets.title: Prime-response phase-space rank predictor

statement_or_tool_contract.statement: Research-only model adapter for predicting finite/asymptotic effective response rank from a derived prime-dominated normalized-response symbol and its dangerous phase-space region.
statement_or_tool_contract.input_contract: A canonical square-shell step n, threshold eta, a phase-preserving candidate normalized-response symbol/model c_n, and explicit model/truncation metadata.
statement_or_tool_contract.output_contract: A predicted dangerous phase-space region, leading effective-rank estimate, boundary/plunge correction class, and an explicit uncertainty/dependency packet.
statement_or_tool_contract.structural_law_or_certificate_target: r_resp(eta;n) is approximated by the phase-space measure of {|c_n|>eta} with a controlled lower-order correction.
statement_or_tool_contract.soundness_scope: Conditional on CJ-TH-20260906-002 and on the particular symbol/model being correctly derived from the normalized response with controlled remainders.
statement_or_tool_contract.hard_failure_boundary: Not proof-safe for RH; do not use a heuristic absolute-value symbol; do not extrapolate outside a declared tested/model envelope; do not replace certified block-inertia counts when certification is required.
reuse_targets: selection of thresholds and truncation sizes for certified inertia tests

assets.claim_scope: Research-only RH square-shell model adapter; no production toolbox status.

validation.validated_envelope: No quantitative prediction envelope yet. Structural probes only for n in {2,3,4}; exact prime-frame decomposition and floating component ablation exist.
validation.summary: The generic Szego/Widom theorem adapter is established mathematics; the conjectural part is this RH-specific normalized-response model adapter and its rank prediction.

known_failures: Pure shell-Shannon 4n prediction is already weakened as a primary model.
No currently proved simple scalar principal symbol for the normalized RH response.
assets.falsifier_or_kill_condition: Failure to derive a stable phase-preserving normalized-response symbol/model, or repeated certified rank data incompatible with the predictor after controlled model/truncation errors.
assets.promotion_target: Prove the RH-specific model-transfer/spectral-count theorem and pass ordinary Enterprise tool acceptance before any production toolbox registration.
assets.notes: Separated from the established generic Wiener-Hopf/Szego-Widom theorem adapter. Only the RH-specific predictive adapter is conjectural.

assets.title: Navier-Stokes 90-degree opposite-edge resonance admits a four-STAR checkerboard native lift

statement_or_tool_contract.statement: On the Enterprise minimal FCC carrier, each classical Navier-Stokes quadratic p·q=0 opposite-edge 90-degree resonant channel admits an exact classical-to-native/P000 four-STAR composite representation whose four shortest STAR-mediated paths have symmetry-matched leading weights; their checkerboard signs cancel the constant leading resonant component, so only a path-imbalance / mixed-second-difference defect survives.

assets.claim_scope: Minimal FCC shell / six-line K4 carrier and the classical-to-native bridge described in the source frontier. This does not assert an already-proved all-scale critical estimate or global regularity conclusion.

proved: Exact K4 opposite-edge identification of the 90-degree resonant shell-4 class
Exact four shortest STAR-mediated paths for every opposite-edge pair
Exact identification of the same 2D checkerboard sector with extensional strain gaps

validation.validated_envelope: Exact carrier combinatorics and signed path algebra on the minimal FCC shell; no exact dynamic coefficient bridge has yet been established.
validation.sample_size_or_exhaustive_count: All three K4 opposite-edge classes at the minimal FCC carrier for the combinatorial/sign portion
validation.summary: The four-path multiplicity, checkerboard signs, mixed-difference form, extensional-sector identification and 90-degree Stokes resonance geometry are exact. The unproved residue is the equality between the classical resonant NS coefficient and the native four-path effective sum with symmetry-matched leading weights.

known_failures: A naive nonresonant quadratic normal form cannot eliminate the p·q=0 channel because its heat/Stokes homological denominator vanishes.
No equality of dynamic path weights for arbitrary states is proved.
No scale-critical estimate for the surviving checkerboard defect is proved.
assets.falsifier_or_kill_condition: An exact evaluation of the classical quadratic coefficient on an admissible minimal-FCC opposite-edge channel showing that no four-STAR representation with the recorded checkerboard signs and symmetry-matched leading weights can reproduce it, or a proof that the required native path weights are generically asymmetric at leading order.
assets.promotion_target: Construct the exact classical-to-native coefficient map, prove equality/symmetry of the four path weights at leading resonant order, and derive the surviving mixed-difference defect formula before attempting any critical estimate.
assets.notes: Backfilled from an explicit 'Main bridge conjecture / open target' source section. Only the asserted bridge mechanism is registered; later regularity estimates remain separate open targets.

assets.title: H_log3 N=8 interior threshold inertia is stable under regular archimedean-tail ablation

statement_or_tool_contract.statement: For the support-exact H_log3 four-branch Dirichlet-sine finite section with N=8 modes per branch, the full threshold-block inertia equals the prime-plus-Cauchy/Carleman reference-block inertia at eta in {0.9,0.99,0.999}; the common negative-inertia counts are respectively {8,6,5}.

assets.claim_scope: Only the declared 32-dimensional N=8 four-branch sine finite section and eta in {0.9,0.99,0.999}. It excludes eta=1 and makes no inference about the Galerkin complement, the infinite H_log3 operator, later square-shell steps or RH.

validation.validated_envelope: Floating support-exact N=8 four-branch sine computation at eta=0.9,0.99,0.999.
validation.sample_size_or_exhaustive_count: 3 declared threshold values on one fixed 32-dimensional finite section
validation.summary: The full, prime-only and prime+Cauchy threshold-inertia counts agree at the three interior thresholds in floating arithmetic. The source explicitly keeps this diagnostic at TESTING pending interval/ball evaluation and interval LDL*.

known_failures: At eta=1 the observed floating minimum eigenvalue is around 7e-13 and is explicitly excluded from this conjecture because ordinary floating sign is not proof data.
Finite-section inertia stability does not imply infinite-operator positivity or RH.
assets.falsifier_or_kill_condition: Interval/ball evaluation plus certified LDL* produces a different inertia count for the full block or the prime+Cauchy/Carleman reference block at any of the three declared thresholds.
assets.promotion_target: Interval/ball-evaluate the finite physical translation integral and certify the three declared threshold inertias by interval LDL*. Because the claim scope is explicitly finite, a complete exact/certified bounded check may promote this asset directly to PROVED for this scope.
assets.notes: This is the canonical bounded-use example of 'register first, use conditionally, certify later'. The statement was deliberately narrowed to interior thresholds that have a stable floating diagnostic.
